mathematical_meanings: Left image: The oval is the ellipse marked with semiaxes along the coordinate axes. Right image: The oval represents the smaller circular rim of the frustum in perspective.
Rationales: The feature traces a plane ellipse on the axes in the left image and shows a circular rim of a solid in perspective in the right image. The plane oval through A1 at x = 4 and A2 at x = −4. The solid upper oval of the truncated cone.
